description: Contains unit tests for RequestContext propagation and behavior within Orleans grain calls, including activity ID propagation, request context setting, thread hopping, and call chain management. The file defines multiple test classes, test methods, and related helpers to verify correct behavior of request context across different scenarios.

classes.name: RequestContextTests_Silo
classes.description: Unit tests for request context propagation in Orleans silo environment, focusing on activity IDs and request setting across grain calls, including complex scenarios involving call chain reentrancy and external proxies.

classes.name: Halo_RequestContextTests
classes.description: Tests verifying that RequestContext values are maintained correctly across thread hopping in async tasks within Orleans tests.

classes.name: Halo_CallContextTests
classes.description: Tests verifying that AsyncLocal-based call context values are preserved correctly during thread switches in Orleans tests.

classes.name: RequestContextGrainObserver
classes.description: A simple observer implementation to test state change notifications with request context logging.

methods.name: ContextTester
methods.description: Helper method for testing request context propagation during thread hopping.

methods.name: FrameworkContextVerification
methods.description: Works alongside ContextTester to verify RequestContext values throughout thread switches.
